li.label: humming at work
li.description: I've been humming at work again. I only notice when someone hums along.

li.label: my stones on the sill
li.description: I keep the stones I find lined up on the sill, smallest to biggest. There's a green one from this week.

li.label: up with the sun
li.description: The best part of the day is the first hour, before anyone else is up.

li.label: past my bedtime
li.description: It's late. I should have been asleep hours ago, and tomorrow starts at dawn whether I like it or not.

li.label: talking to the plants
li.description: I talk to the plants while I tend them. They don't answer, but they grow.

li.label: wearing red
li.description: I've got red on, and red is bad luck. I know it's silly, and I still keep looking over my shoulder.

li.label: with my named animals
li.description: Every animal here has a name, because I gave it one. They answer to them, some of them.

li.label: this place is a mess
li.description: Crumbs on the table and mud on the floor. I can't think straight in a room like this.

li.label: singing at the stove
li.description: I sing when I cook. The same three songs, mostly. The food comes out better for it, I'm sure of it.

li.label: under the stars
li.description: I come out most nights to look at the stars. I've given the bright ones names of my own.

li.label: checked the doors
li.description: I check every door before I sleep, twice. Then I can sleep.

li.label: always cold
li.description: Everyone else says it isn't that cold. My hands and feet say otherwise.

li.label: the birds know me
li.description: I keep crusts in my pocket for the birds. They come when they see me now.

li.label: the quiet hours
li.description: Everyone's asleep and the colony is mine for a while. I get more done, and I think better.

li.label: stuck in bed
li.description: I can't sit still at the best of times, and they want me lying here all day.

li.label: talking to the dead
li.description: I told them how the harvest went and who's been quarrelling. They're good listeners.
